method: User-authorized native app interaction through Computer Use
app: rednote / com.xingin.discover, installed iOS app running on macOS
scope: Actual local app UI, not browser mobile emulation and not an iPhone device test
observations: Center + opens a menu with album, camera and text entries.
Text entry generates a card, then opens the final publisher.
Final publisher puts small image thumbnails and Add image in a horizontal row, followed by title and body.
Auxiliary rows are below the body; a content statement opens a bottom sheet.
Save draft is a smaller secondary action; Post is the wider primary action fixed at the bottom.
Exiting offers explicit discard or save draft choices.
cleanup: Discard content at final publisher, Discard at image selection, Discard at text editor, then close the now-empty text entry. Returned to app Home.
